howto: Press Play. Watch the animals sing.
Tap them in the same order.
Finish all the rounds with few mistakes for 3 stars.
tips: Hum the tune in your head.
The ear button plays the round again.
You have three hearts on each level.
Jam lets you play the animals freely.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 4 tap the pads, R replays. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: 15 levels in three bands. Sequences grow from 3 to 12 sounds and the tune speeds up.

cheats.effect: Slow Simon: the animals sing almost twice as slowly
Show next: the pad to tap next is outlined

features.hints: The ear button replays the round; Pause > Hint names the next animal
features.undo: Hearts forgive mistakes: the round replays
features.level-select-or-daily: Level map with stars and a daily goal
